title: Healthy habits
examples: What is the best way to wash my hands?
How many times should I brush my teeth?
What foods help me grow strong?

explain.say: Healthy habits help your body stay well. First, you wash your hands.

draw.text: Wash hands with soap and water.

explain.say: Wet your hands with running water. Put on some soap. Rub your hands together for twenty seconds.
Rinse all the soap off your hands. Dry them with a clean towel. This washes germs away.
Brush your teeth in the morning and before bed. Use a pea-sized bit of toothpaste. Brush in small circles on every tooth.
Eat lots of everyday foods, like fruit, vegetables and bread. Cake and sweets are sometimes foods.
Wash your hands before you eat and after the toilet. Wash them after playing outside too.
Sleep helps your body rest and grow. Go to bed at the same time each night.

draw.text: Sleep helps you rest and grow

faq.q: When should I wash my hands?
faq.a: You should wash your hands before you eat food. You should also wash them after using the toilet.
asks: When do I wash my hands?
What is the right time to wash hands?

faq.q: How long should I brush my teeth?
faq.a: Brush for about two minutes, in the morning and before bed. A grown-up can help you.
asks: Do I brush for a minute or two?

faq.a: Eating many kinds of food helps you grow. Fruit, vegetables, bread and milk are everyday foods.
asks: What kinds of food are good?
Can you name the food groups?

faq.a: Sleep helps your body and your brain rest. When you sleep, your body gets ready for the next day.
asks: Why do I need to sleep?

faq.q: What should I do before I eat?
faq.a: You must wash your hands with soap and water. This washes away tiny germs you might pick up.
asks: Do I wash hands before meals?

facts: Washing hands removes germs from your skin.
Brushing teeth helps keep your mouth healthy.
Eating fruits and vegetables gives you vitamins.
Getting enough sleep helps you learn and play.

quiz.say: Think of coming in from play. Tap what you do before eating.
quiz.why: Washing your hands takes away dirt and germs from playing.

wrong.0: A nap helps you rest, but your hands still have germs on them.
wrong.2: Brushing cleans your teeth, and your hands need washing too.

quiz.say: Look at the foods. Tap the everyday food.
quiz.why: An apple is an everyday food. Fruit helps your body grow and stay well.

wrong.0: Cake is a sometimes food, for special days like a party.
wrong.1: Sweets are a sometimes food, so you have them now and then.

quiz.say: Think about your teeth. Tap how often you brush them.
quiz.why: Brush in the morning and before bed. That is twice a day.

wrong.1: Food and germs stay on your teeth every day, so brush every day.
wrong.2: Brush before bed too, so your teeth are clean all night.
